item.title: CISSP
item.description:
This contains the notes for CISSP Preperation.

Welcome to my notes section.

# Topic Description
1 D0 CISSP Prep
 The page contains metrics, common pit falls and mitigations
2 D1 Security and Risk Management
 Governance, risk management, compliance, ethics, policies, and security principles.
3 D2 Asset Security Classify, own, protect, retain, and securely dispose of information and assets.
4 D3 Security Architecture and Engineering Design and implement secure systems using security models, principles, and controls.
5 D4 Communication and Network Security Secure network architecture, protocols, transmission methods, and communications.
6 D5 Identity and Access Management Ensure the right user gets the right access to the right resource at the right time.
7 D6 Security Assessment and Testing Evaluate security controls through audits, assessments, testing, and reporting.
8 D7 Security Operations Maintain security through monitoring, incident response, recovery, logging, and operational processes.
9 D8 Software Development Security Integrate security throughout the SDLC, from requirements and design through deployment and maintenance.
